summary: argo-cd D61's test clause is rewritten in place (AnsibleSpecs 4e91587): deploy repos run no tests in Jenkins, PrometheusDeploy's local test verb checks and unit-tests its alert rules (slice 027), and each retired HelmCharts test keeps its own reason. The routing test's successor is slice 028 P3, and grafana's login test restated its release's values and read HelmCharts' dev copy. history.md gains the narrative of how the position moved. Close-out Q1 asks the operator to confirm the two reasons P5 wrote, since the plan's CronJob-timing premise holds for only three of the five prometheus tests.
